en: I nod lightly, biting my lip gently as I squirm on his lap.
Alright, go for it. Six fuckbucks in total, right?
His hands cup my #Syn_Tits# instantly, leaning in to whisper into my ear as his fingers massage my soft womanly flesh.
Of course... This body of yours is worth it. Your owner is a lucky man.
I shrug lightly, trying to keep up my composure as he squishes my #Syn_Tits# back and forth.
Just uh... Just eat your veggies and you can have one like it too!
He chuckles softly, his hot breath tickling the back of my neck and causing the hairs there to stand up.
That's cute. Is this your lap comedy routine?
I nod lightly, my face blushing a bright pink.
Are we almost done? It's been a few minutes now.
He nods lightly, patting my #Syn_Tits# one final time.
You're done.
I'll do it if you give me some... ugh... 'fuckbucks'.
Fuckbucks for a lap sit? I could get a few booth sessions with that sorta money!
I'll give you one fuckbuck if you sit down on my lap.
Fuck it, fine.
I step over and tentatively sit down on his lap, squeezing my legs shut and resting my hands on my thighs.
Atta girl...
Yeah, yeah. How long do I have to stay here?
He stays silent for a moment, thinking.
One minute.
I cross my legs and arms, pausing as I feel something stiff poking against my rear.
Is that?
He lets out a sheepish chuckle, rubbing the back of his head as I adjust myself to inch away from his poking package.
I'll give you five extra fuckbucks if you let me at those #Syn_Tits# of yours.
Let him grope your #Syn_Tits#.
Get off his lap.
Not a chance!
Aw damn. Oh well. That ass was still worth it.
The man looks me up and down with a small scoff.
Sorry. I only prefer women in blue skintight suits and yellow jackets. Come back when you're wearing that hot outfit I saw you in before.
Right...
Someone was playing a little rough with you, hm?
Yeah, yeah.
Should I go to sleep?
Nighty night ~
HEY! She’s with me, hands off!
You sure about that? She looks like she just wandered in from the middle of nowhere.
I’m dead sure.. Unless you’d rather lose access to my fine establishment.
... Fine.
I hear the zippers zip back up, and then the guard releases my wrist. I shoot up to my feet and take a few steps away from the pair.
That’s it. In you come, dear. Thank you for your cooperation, guards.
The two guards grumble in disappointment, before wandering off.
Come on in, let’s get you out of the rain.
Yeah.. Sure thing.
Hello there young Lady, what can I do for you?
I was wondering if I could work here for some money.
Well.. I guess you could go ahead and dust off all the furniture.
If you pay me for it..
Of course, little Jenna!
Fine, I'll do it.
Delightfull!
On my way.
So the hacking app should work like a memory game. I just have to find the matching pairs.
I find another way to open the door.
Never mind you seem busy with the generator.
Come back if you change your mind.
<color=perversion><color=perversion>ghuuuhhh</color></color>
Nice cock.
No one is home and by the look of it, the house wasn't used recently. But we found a console and another door that leads upstairs. You found a way to open the door?
Yeah, I got a hacking app from the tin foil guy. He hacked my phone, I don't know how I should feel about it. First my suit now my phone.
Where is Rida by the way?
She found a room with training equipment and wanted to look around there
I see.
I found the generator room I try to get us some light in here. You guys should also look around.
I try to open the door to the basement.
I'm gonna take a look around.
Same.
I don't want to trouble you.
You know where to find me.
You know where Rida is.
(Get it together Jenna. I still need to open the door downstairs.)
(No Badge-...)
(I can't leave like this...!)
(It's a bad idea to leave without the badge...!)
(I gotta clean up before I can leave.)
<color=perversion>Let's see what Leila is up to, hehehe..~</color>
Rida ready.
Carcen need help?
You changed your mind ?
Ready when you are.
Let's see what is hidden inside!
#Syn_SignAddiction<nocap>#
(These guys sure are barrels of fun!)
(HQ's still doing some remote tinkering on my vibrosuit. I can't dash until he's done... I'll just have to get close the old fashioned way!)
Path is closed down due to construction work
(Phew... Looks like my clothes are at least dry enough to not reveal anything now.)
Whoops! Looks like you lot need some more guys! Four versus one isn’t nearly fair enough for you!
That's two down! Come on guys, Peitho has to have trained you better than this!
Ring!
(What? Who could be calling me now? Gotta be those Peitho kidnappers.)
Click!
Jenna here!
Sweetheart? Is that you?
Karen?! Did they hurt you? Where are you?
I'm fine, I'm okay- Is that gunfire?
Uhhh no! Don't know what you're talking about, love!
They-- ow! Alright, alright, jeez! They wanted me to tell you that 'The clock is ticking, Wright'.
Like hell it is.. Everything's going to be fine, Karen. Don't you worry about a thing.
I fall to the ground in defeat, clutching my torso with a pained expression.
Holy shit! We did it! We actually did it!
Agh.. Don’t.. D-Don’t know what y-you mean… I can still-
Shut up, bitch. You’re going to get us rewarded nicely.
The soldier approaches me quickly, ignoring my weak attempts to crawl away. He kicks me over onto my stomach and I feel something impact the back of my head, knocking me out cold.
(Well that’s no good, it’s locked…)
I like your outfit a lot better like this, hehe...
Why don't you come with me to my house and enjoy some coffee with me there?
Not even in your wildest dreams, bud!
(I should report him to-)
Suddenly he reaches for my ass, squeezing and groping at it.
With a frustrated sigh, I give him the hardest bitch slap I can muster.
Bad move, pal! You're lucky I'm in a damn rush or I'd call the cops on your stupid ass in a heartbeat!
I-I'm sorry! T-..They.. m-made me... I-
Bugger off!
(I'm done with this dickhead.)
You, girl! Get me some coffee, dammit!
Coffee? What?
Yes coffee, you idiot girl! I’m gonna have a goddamn fit if I don’t have my coffee! If you’re gonna trespass on my goddamn land, get me my goddamn coffee!
(Sheesh. I don't have time for this...)
Try to reason with him.
Force your way past him.
Come on, bud! Gotta help a hero out here. Can you just open that gate? I'm in a bit of a rush.
Hero? I know those old AIRSHIP heroes, but I don't know you, girl. Get me my goddamn coffee and I'll open the goddamn gate!
Really? You don't know me? I was with AIRSHIP... I helped fight in the... the second crisis...
He just glares at me silently, my voice trailing off.
Alright, alright. No worries, I’ll get you your coffee. Where can I get some?
In my house. Gah, here.. take my extra key, but you better goddamn be back with my goddamn coffee soon.
Alright, you can count on me!
Look pal, my girlfriend's in danger and I don't have any time to waste. Get out of my way, please!
Fhah! The nerve of you! This is my property, and I want my damn coffee!
Okay, that's it.
I draw my zap pistols and aim past him, shooting out the gate's lock.
EEK! You're one of those... I'm reporting you to the authorities, you dirty vigilante!
Go for it.
He rushes past me to his house. I can hear the slam of his door in the distance.
Tea's better anyways.
(I can't wait any longer to dry my clothes...)
What happened to you? Your outfit looks a lot better now, hahaha.
Ugh... Just take your coffee and open the damn gate.
I hand the steaming mug of coffee over to him. He snatches it out of my hand and takes a few quick sips.
Sure, sexy. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’m going to.. enjoy this.
Whatever, pal...
Are you slow?
GET ME MY COFFEE!!
Okay, okay!
(These guys don't look too tough. I bet I can easily take them out if I get close!)
(Hmm... I coulda sworn there were some bad guys to beat up over here.)
(That entrance is gone too... Gotta find a way to open it back up.)
(Yep... Lots of ground coffee in here. This guy must be a hit at parties.)
(Filled with even more coffee grinds. How much can one guy drink?)
(Sheets are all nice and tidy.)
(I can't leave without the man's coffee, this is a life or death situation!)
(Alright. Looks like coffee, smells like coffee, and will probably calm that guy down.)
As I look down to grab the coffee, I notice how see-through my suit has become.
(... Shit! I.. I can't go out like this!)
(B-.. But.. I don't have time for this! Hopefully it'll dry quickly when I get outside.)
I bend down and peek into the chest, searching around for a cup.
(Can't believe I'm making coffee for this guy, better hurry it up so I can find Karen.)
(Looks like the guy didn't even have a pot ready. Gonna have to brew some coffee myself.)
I lift the lid of the barrel open, digging inside for some of the coffee grinds.
(This guy has enough coffee to last him for years! He would probably love to live off of it...)
(Nothing on his shelves... Does this guy care about anything but coffee?)
(Wow. He keeps his dishes pretty clean, or at least hides the dirty ones somewhere.)
(I still need #Items#!)

This is Atlas News with something that most of you probably already know. It's been exactly a year now since the massacre of the Second Crisis. We ask that you join us in a moment of silence for the lost lives and broken families, andro and human alike.
(It's been a whole year...? Feels just like yesterday...)
Thank you. Now we turn our attention back to the topic at hand-
Here we go again... "Rogue agents oper-"

-operating illegally after all these months since AIRSHIP's official shutdown! It is unacceptable that these vigilantes still see fit to impose their will when their little clubhouse was closed down for their role in that horrible massacre!
(That wasn't our fault!)
(I should get back to what I was doing... I can't rescue Karen like this.)
Come on, Jenna. You're better than this. No need to go snooping around in this guy's drawers.
The rusty faucet makes a light creaking sound as I turn it, water starting to pour down into the sink.
(Hope he likes tap water.)
I chuckle quietly to myself, finding an empty cup beside the coffee machine and filling it up with water.
(There we go, easy.)
As if on cue a loud squeaking comes from the tap, water starting to spray out onto my front as I quickly struggle to get the faucet closed again.
(Ughh... Great.)
I keep my arms held out gingerly as water drips down onto the floor from them, grabbing a towel from beside the sink and trying to dry my clothes as best as I can.
(I don't have time for this...)
What a nice day for some rescuing!
HQ? You there, pal? I made it to the spot where you said the bad guys were. Got anything for me? Have we heard anything from Karen's kidnappers?
:: I read you, Jen. Nothing new on this end. You really should wait for backup to get there, you could be walking right into a trap! ::
No big deal! It's just Peitho! I've been tearing through these guys easy.
:: Hm, alright. I've since lost the signal on the group of Peitho operatives I've been tracking, but it dropped somewhere in that region. ::
So they must have something in the area jamming the signal, right?
:: That was my thought as well. Either that or they found the tracker you slapped on their getaway ship. ::
Alrighty. Keep me updated on developments, okay?
:: Every chance I can get... and don't worry. We'll get you two lovebirds back together. ::
That's the plan, Henry... I'll take a look around and get back to you. Jenna out!
